-- v8 7 (build review 1 M1): the phone text floor on a 308 px window (the phone size with a 58 px top bar), on PC
function S.v8phone()
	local r = report()
	v8open()
	local pp = page()
	press("Tab_7") press("Card_6")
	local zones = {"Tab1", "Tab7", "Header", "Card1", "Card6", "Reward", "Total", "Inspect"}
	local before = {}
	for _, n in zones do before[n] = pp[n].Position end
	local base = win.Size
	win.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 308 / mm.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	task.wait(0.7)
	r.check("308 px window: PhoneText on", pp:GetAttribute("PhoneText") == true, ("h %d scale %.3f"):format(win.AbsoluteSize.Y, pp.CanvasScale.Scale))
	local moved = {}
	for _, n in zones do if pp[n].Position ~= before[n] then table.insert(moved, n) end end
	r.check("phone: no zone moved (one layout)", #moved == 0, table.concat(moved, ","))
	local clash = {}
	for k = 1, 4 do
		local L, V = pp.Inspect["Stat" .. k].L, pp.Inspect["Stat" .. k].V
		local lr = L.AbsolutePosition.X + L.TextBounds.X
		local vl = V.AbsolutePosition.X + V.AbsoluteSize.X - V.TextBounds.X
		if lr > vl - 2 then table.insert(clash, "Stat" .. k) end
	end
	r.check("stat label text ends before its value text", #clash == 0, table.concat(clash, ","))
	local grew = 0
	for _, t in {pp.Inspect.Stat3.L, pp.Total.Bar.Text, pp.Reward.Title} do if t.UITextSizeConstraint.MaxTextSize > 20 then grew += 1 end end
	r.check("phone caps raised (13 px on screen)", grew == 3, grew)
	win.Size = base
	task.wait(0.7)
	r.check("PC size again: PhoneText off, v8 rects + caps back", pp:GetAttribute("PhoneText") == false and pp.Header.Face.Area.Size == UDim2.fromScale(0.47, 0.47)
		and pp.Inspect.Stat1.L.Size == UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48) and pp.Inspect.Stat1.L.UITextSizeConstraint.MaxTextSize == 13)
	return r.text("v8phone")
end
